name: word-roller-outline-highlight
title: Word Roller Outline Highlight
description: The same word stacked seven times as an outline; a solid, slightly larger copy travels down the stack, slow, then fast, then easing, and settles on the last row with a spring.
useWhen: An opening word (introducing, welcome, presenting) that should feel like a spotlight running down a list.
A bold title with an outline pattern behind it.
avoidWhen: Several different words: this block repeats a single word.
Long words: seven rows of it need a lot of width.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Word
variables.description: The word repeated down the stack.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. The stack shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Highlight color
variables.description: Color of the solid copy and the outlines.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
